hadi-march/motion#MORPH_ICONS.name: MORPH_ICONS
hadi-march/motion#MORPH_ICONS.doc: Morphable icon outlines (24×24, filled). Any name morphs into any other.
hadi-march/motion#MORPH_ICONS.signature: const MORPH_ICONS: { readonly play: string; readonly pause: string; readonly menu: string; readonly close: string; readonly plus: string; readonly check: string; readonly minus: string; }
hadi-march/motion#MORPH_ICONS.valueType: { readonly play: string; readonly pause: string; readonly menu: string; readonly close: string; readonly plus: string; readonly check: string; readonly minus: string; }
hadi-march/motion#MORPH_ICONS.tr: Dönüştürülebilir simge ana hatları (24×24, dolu). Herhangi bir ad diğerine dönüşebilir.

hadi-march/motion#morphBack.name: morphBack
hadi-march/motion#morphBack.doc: `from` (shown) shrinks into `to`'s box; `to` is shown again at the end. Remove or close `from` after `finished`.
hadi-march/motion#morphBack.signature: function morphBack(from: Element, to: Element, o: MorphOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#morphBack.tr: Görünen `from`, `to` kutusuna küçülür; sonunda `to` yeniden gösterilir. `finished` sonrası `from` öğesini kaldırın veya kapatın.

hadi-march/motion#morphIcon.name: morphIcon
hadi-march/motion#morphIcon.doc: Morph an icon <path> into another MORPH_ICONS shape (or any `d` with the same commands).
hadi-march/motion#morphIcon.signature: function morphIcon(path: Element, to: MorphIconName | string, o: AnimateOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#morphIcon.tr: Bir simge <path> öğesini başka bir MORPH_ICONS şekline (veya aynı komutlara sahip herhangi bir `d`) dönüştürür.

hadi-march/motion#morphPage.name: morphPage
hadi-march/motion#morphPage.doc: Morph: the new page grows out of the pressed link or card (rounded box → full page).
hadi-march/motion#morphPage.tr: Dönüşüm: yeni sayfa basılan bağlantı veya karttan büyür (yuvarlak kutu → tam sayfa).

hadi-march/motion#morphPath.name: morphPath
hadi-march/motion#morphPath.doc: Morph a <path> into another `d`. Returns the Playback; at the end `d` is exactly `to`.
hadi-march/motion#morphPath.signature: function morphPath(el: Element, to: string, o: MorphPathOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#morphPath.tr: Bir <path> öğesini başka bir `d` değerine dönüştürür. Playback döndürür; sonunda `d` tam olarak `to` olur.

hadi-march/motion#MOTION_DEFAULTS.name: MOTION_DEFAULTS
hadi-march/motion#MOTION_DEFAULTS.doc: Default motion settings (speed 1, reduced motion from the system, 240 ms, "out" easing).
hadi-march/motion#MOTION_DEFAULTS.value: { speed: 1, reduce: "system", duration: 240, easing: "out", slowMo: 1, character: "default" }
hadi-march/motion#MOTION_DEFAULTS.tr: Varsayılan hareket ayarları (hız 1, azaltılmış hareket sistemden, 240 ms, "out" yumuşatma).

hadi-march/motion#motion.name: motion
hadi-march/motion#motion.doc: Global motion control: speed, pause all, reduced motion, defaults, settings saved per user.
hadi-march/motion#motion.signature: const motion: { config: (patch?: Partial<MotionSettings>, o?: { persist?: boolean; }) => MotionSettings; settings: () => MotionSettings; reset: () => MotionSettings; paused: () => boolean; reduced: () => boolean; pauseAll(): void; resumeAll(): void; togglePause(): boolean; now: { paused: () => boolean; reduced: () => boolean; }; }
hadi-march/motion#motion.valueType: { config: (patch?: Partial<MotionSettings>, o?: { persist?: boolean; }) => MotionSettings; settings: () => MotionSettings; reset: () => MotionSettings; paused: () => boolean; reduced: () => boolean; pauseAll(): void; resumeAll(): void; togglePause(): boolean; now: { paused: () => boolean; reduced: () => boolean; }; }
hadi-march/motion#motion.tr: Genel hareket denetimi: hız, tümünü duraklat, azaltılmış hareket, varsayılanlar, kullanıcı başına kaydedilen ayarlar.

hadi-march/motion#mutate.name: mutate
hadi-march/motion#mutate.doc: Batch a DOM write into the next frame's write phase (after every read).
hadi-march/motion#mutate.tr: Bir DOM yazmasını sonraki karenin yazma aşamasına (tüm okumalardan sonra) toplu ekler.

hadi-march/motion#navDirection.name: navDirection
hadi-march/motion#navDirection.doc: Direction of the navigation now (for tests and custom wrappers).
hadi-march/motion#navDirection.tr: Şu anki gezinmenin yönü (testler ve özel sarmalayıcılar için).

hadi-march/motion#nextFrame.name: nextFrame
hadi-march/motion#nextFrame.doc: Run `fn` once on the next frame (in the given phase). Returns a cancel function.
hadi-march/motion#nextFrame.signature: function nextFrame(fn: FrameFn, phase: Phase = "update"): () => void
hadi-march/motion#nextFrame.tr: `fn` işlevini sonraki karede (verilen aşamada) bir kez çalıştırır. İptal işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#normalize.name: normalize
hadi-march/motion#normalize.doc: Normalize keyframes into one raw track per property (offsets filled in like CSS does).
hadi-march/motion#normalize.tr: Anahtar kareleri özellik başına bir ham ize normalleştirir (ofsetler CSS gibi doldurulur).

hadi-march/motion#onFrame.name: onFrame
hadi-march/motion#onFrame.doc: Run `fn(time, dt)` every frame until the returned function is called.
hadi-march/motion#onFrame.signature: function onFrame(fn: FrameFn, o: FrameOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#onFrame.tr: Döndürülen işlev çağrılana dek her karede `fn(time, dt)` çalıştırır.

hadi-march/motion#onScrollProgress.name: onScrollProgress
hadi-march/motion#onScrollProgress.doc: Call `fn(progress)` whenever the scroll (or the size) changes, once per frame in the read phase.
hadi-march/motion#onScrollProgress.signature: function onScrollProgress(o: ScrollSource, fn: (p: number) => void): () => void
hadi-march/motion#onScrollProgress.tr: Kaydırma (ya da boyut) değiştikçe, okuma evresinde kare başına bir kez `fn(progress)` çağırır.

hadi-march/motion#PAGE_VARIANTS.name: PAGE_VARIANTS
hadi-march/motion#PAGE_VARIANTS.value: [circle, wipe, stack, cube, flip, zoomThrough, curtain, blinds, pixelDissolve, morphPage]

hadi-march/motion#pageTransitions.name: pageTransitions
hadi-march/motion#pageTransitions.doc: Turn page transitions on. Returns a function that turns them off.
hadi-march/motion#pageTransitions.tr: Sayfa geçişlerini açar. Onları kapatan bir işlev döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#parallax.name: parallax
hadi-march/motion#parallax.doc: Action: move the element at `speed` × scroll (negative = opposite). transform only.
hadi-march/motion#parallax.signature: function parallax(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#parallax.tr: Eylem: öğeyi kaydırma × `speed` oranında hareket ettirir (negatif = ters yön). Yalnızca transform.

hadi-march/motion#parallaxLayers.name: parallaxLayers
hadi-march/motion#parallaxLayers.doc: Layers (`[data-depth]`, -1…1) move at their own speed while the container passes through view.
hadi-march/motion#parallaxLayers.signature: function parallaxLayers(container: Element, o: ParallaxLayersOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#parallaxLayers.tr: Katmanlar (`[data-depth]`, -1…1) kapsayıcı görünümden geçerken kendi hızlarında kayar.

hadi-march/motion#parseColor.name: parseColor
hadi-march/motion#parseColor.doc: Parse a CSS color into premultiplied OKLab + alpha: out = [L·α, a·α, b·α, α]. Returns false when `s` is not a color this parser knows (hex, rgb(), oklab(), oklch(), transparent / black / white; others such as hsl() switch halfway in JS and stay native in CSS).
hadi-march/motion#parseColor.signature: function parseColor(input: string, out: Float64Array | number[], i: number = 0): boolean
hadi-march/motion#parseColor.tr: Bir CSS rengini önceden çarpılmış OKLab + alfa olarak ayrıştırır: out = [L·α, a·α, b·α, α]. `s` bu ayrıştırıcının bilmediği bir renkse false döndürür (hex, rgb(), oklab(), oklch(), transparent / black / white; hsl() gibi diğerleri desteklenmez).

hadi-march/motion#parsePath.name: parsePath
hadi-march/motion#parsePath.doc: Split a `d` string into commands with their numbers (implicit repeats made explicit).
hadi-march/motion#parsePath.tr: Bir `d` dizesini sayılarıyla komutlara böler (örtük tekrarlar açık hale getirilir).

hadi-march/motion#pathLength.name: pathLength
hadi-march/motion#pathLength.doc: Total length of a path (all subpaths).
hadi-march/motion#pathLength.tr: Bir yolun toplam uzunluğu (tüm alt yollar).

hadi-march/motion#pathSampler.name: pathSampler
hadi-march/motion#pathSampler.doc: A sampler along the path: `at(p)` for p in 0..1 gives the point and the tangent angle (degrees).
hadi-march/motion#pathSampler.tr: Yol boyunca örnekleyici: `at(p)` (p 0..1) noktayı ve teğet açısını (derece) verir.

hadi-march/motion#pixelDissolve.name: pixelDissolve
hadi-march/motion#pixelDissolve.doc: Pixel dissolve: the new page appears cell by cell.
hadi-march/motion#pixelDissolve.tr: Piksel çözülmesi: yeni sayfa hücre hücre belirir.

hadi-march/motion#Playback.name: Playback
hadi-march/motion#Playback.doc: A timeline of animations with labels, play, pause, seek, reverse and speed.

members.name: items
members.summary: The effects and nested playbacks with their start positions.

members.name: labels
members.summary: Named time positions added with label().

members.name: parent
members.summary: The playback this one is nested in, or null for a root.

members.name: state
members.summary: Whether the playback is idle, running, paused or finished.

members.name: essential
members.summary: True when the playback keeps running under reduced motion instead of jumping to its end state.

members.name: onUpdate
members.signature: onUpdate: ((progress: number, time: number) => void) | undefined
members.summary: Called on every update with the progress (0..1) and the current time in ms.

members.name: onComplete
members.summary: Called once when the playback finishes.

members.name: defaults
members.summary: The options applied to every animation added to this playback.

members.name: add
members.signature: add(target: Target | Playback, frames?: KeyframesInput, opts: StepOptions = {}): this
members.summary: Add an animation of `target` (or a nested playback) at a position.

members.name: label
members.signature: label(name: string, at?: number | string): this
members.summary: A named position (`tl.label("intro", 400)`; default: the current end).

members.name: call
members.signature: call(fn: () => void, at?: number | string): this
members.summary: Call `fn` when playback passes `at` (either direction).

members.name: duration
members.summary: Total length in ms (Infinity when something loops forever).

members.name: currentTime
members.summary: The current position in ms; setting it seeks.

members.name: playbackRate
members.summary: The playback speed multiplier; setting it changes the speed immediately.

members.name: finished
members.summary: Resolves when it finishes (or is cancelled).

members.name: progress
members.summary: 0..1 (reactive).

members.name: animation
members.summary: The first native animation (compatibility with the old Controls).

members.name: then
members.signature: then<A = void, B = never>(ok?: ((v: void) => A | PromiseLike<A>) | null, err?: ((e: unknown) => B | PromiseLike<B>) | null): Promise<A | B>
members.summary: Await the end: `await animate(el, "fadeIn")`.

members.name: play
members.summary: Starts or resumes the playback from the current position.

members.name: pause
members.summary: Pauses the playback at the current position.

members.name: reverse
members.summary: Play backwards from where it is (or forwards again).

members.name: seek
members.summary: Jump to a time (ms) or a label; keeps the play state.

members.name: finish
members.summary: Jump to the end and finish.

members.name: cancel
members.summary: Stop and remove every effect (elements return to their own styles).

members.name: syncRate
members.summary: Global speed or own rate changed.

members.name: syncPause
members.summary: Global pause changed.

hadi-march/motion#Playback.tr: Etiketli, oynat, duraklat, ara, ters çevir ve hız destekli animasyon zaman çizelgesi.

hadi-march/motion#pointerDrag.name: pointerDrag
hadi-march/motion#pointerDrag.doc: Start a drag from a pointerdown event. Returns `stop()` (ends it as cancelled).
hadi-march/motion#pointerDrag.signature: function pointerDrag(down: PointerEvent, o: PointerDragOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#pointerDrag.tr: Bir pointerdown olayından sürüklemeyi başlatır. `stop()` döndürür (iptal edilmiş olarak bitirir).

hadi-march/motion#preset.name: preset
hadi-march/motion#preset.doc: A preset: existing keyframes with other timing (`preset("modalIn", "zoomIn", { duration: 180, easing: "spring" })`).
hadi-march/motion#preset.signature: function preset(name: string, use: string, defaults: Timing = {}): void
hadi-march/motion#preset.tr: Ön ayar: başka zamanlamalı mevcut anahtar kareler (`preset("modalIn", "zoomIn", { duration: 180, easing: "spring" })`).

hadi-march/motion#press.name: press
hadi-march/motion#press.doc: Action: subtle press-down scale; `{ scale, easing }` for a springy release (`easing: "spring-wobbly"`).
hadi-march/motion#press.signature: function press(el: Element, raw?: Opts<number | { scale?: number; easing?: string }>): () => void
hadi-march/motion#press.tr: Eylem: ince basma ölçeği; yaylı bırakma için `{ scale, easing }` (`easing: "spring-wobbly"`).

hadi-march/motion#reducedMotion.name: reducedMotion
hadi-march/motion#reducedMotion.doc: True when the user asked for reduced motion (live). Animations shorten to a near-instant fade or skip.
hadi-march/motion#reducedMotion.tr: Kullanıcı azaltılmış hareket istediyse true (canlı). Animasyonlar neredeyse anlık solmaya kısalır veya atlanır.

hadi-march/motion#registerVar.name: registerVar
hadi-march/motion#registerVar.doc: Register a CSS custom property so it animates smoothly (natively): `registerVar("--hue", "<number>", "0")`.
hadi-march/motion#registerVar.signature: function registerVar(name: string, syntax: string, initial: string, inherits: boolean = true): boolean
hadi-march/motion#registerVar.tr: Bir CSS özel özelliğini yumuşakça (yerel olarak) canlanması için kaydeder: `registerVar("--hue", "<number>", "0")`.

hadi-march/motion#resample.name: resample
hadi-march/motion#resample.doc: `n` points evenly spaced along the path's longest subpath: [x0, y0, x1, y1, …].
hadi-march/motion#resample.signature: function resample(d: string, n: number = 64): { pts: number[]; closed: boolean }
hadi-march/motion#resample.tr: Yolun en uzun alt yolu boyunca eşit aralıklı `n` nokta: [x0, y0, x1, y1, …].

hadi-march/motion#resolveTransition.name: resolveTransition
hadi-march/motion#resolveTransition.doc: `meta.transition` may also be a function of the route params (one route, several transitions).
hadi-march/motion#resolveTransition.signature: function resolveTransition(base: PageTransitionSpec, to: TransitionSide | null | undefined, from: TransitionSide | null | undefined, dir: Dir): ResolvedTransition
hadi-march/motion#resolveTransition.tr: `meta.transition` rota parametrelerinin bir işlevi de olabilir (bir rota, birden çok geçiş).

hadi-march/motion#reveal.name: reveal
hadi-march/motion#reveal.doc: Action: fade/slide in once when visible. `use:reveal={{ delay: 100, frames }}`
hadi-march/motion#reveal.signature: function reveal(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#reveal.tr: Eylem: görününce bir kez solarak/kayarak girer. `use:reveal={{ delay: 100, frames }}`

hadi-march/motion#ripple.name: ripple
hadi-march/motion#ripple.doc: Action: an ink ripple from where the element was pressed (Enter / Space: from the centre).
hadi-march/motion#ripple.signature: function ripple(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#ripple.tr: Eylem: öğeye basılan yerden mürekkep dalgası (Enter / Space: merkezden).

hadi-march/motion#rollDigits.name: rollDigits
hadi-march/motion#rollDigits.doc: Roll `box` from `from` to `to`: only the changed characters move.
hadi-march/motion#rollDigits.signature: function rollDigits(box: HTMLElement, from: string, to: string, o: RollOptions = {}): void
hadi-march/motion#rollDigits.tr: `box` değerini `from`dan `to`ya yuvarlar: yalnız değişen karakterler hareket eder.

hadi-march/motion#scrollFraction.name: scrollFraction
hadi-march/motion#scrollFraction.doc: Progress (0..1) of `track` through the scrollport of `source` (no track: the scroll position itself).
hadi-march/motion#scrollFraction.tr: `track` öğesinin `source` kaydırma alanındaki ilerlemesi (0..1); track yoksa kaydırma konumunun kendisi.

hadi-march/motion#scrollIndicator.name: scrollIndicator
hadi-march/motion#scrollIndicator.doc: A scroll progress bar: the element scales from the inline start (RTL: the right) to full.
hadi-march/motion#scrollIndicator.signature: function scrollIndicator(el: HTMLElement, o: IndicatorOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#scrollIndicator.tr: Kaydırma ilerleme çubuğu: öğe satır başından (RTL'de sağdan) tam genişliğe ölçeklenir.

hadi-march/motion#scrollProgress.name: scrollProgress
hadi-march/motion#scrollProgress.doc: Scroll progress 0..1 (signal) of the page, or of an element passing through the viewport. Cleans up with the current owner.
hadi-march/motion#scrollProgress.signature: function scrollProgress(target?: Element | (() => Element | null)): () => number
hadi-march/motion#scrollProgress.tr: Sayfanın veya görünüm alanından geçen bir öğenin kaydırma ilerlemesi 0..1 (sinyal). Geçerli sahiple birlikte temizlenir.

hadi-march/motion#scrollTimeline.name: scrollTimeline
hadi-march/motion#scrollTimeline.doc: Bind a Playback to scroll: its progress follows the scroll position (a paused animation seeked each frame). Pass keyframes (target + frames) or a ready Playback / timeline. Returns a stop function.
hadi-march/motion#scrollTimeline.signature: function scrollTimeline(target: unknown, frames?: KeyframesInput | null, o: ScrollTimelineOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#scrollTimeline.tr: Bir Playback'i kaydırmaya bağlar: ilerlemesi kaydırma konumunu izler (her karede konumlanan duraklatılmış animasyon). Anahtar kareler (hedef + kareler) ya da hazır bir Playback / zaman çizelgesi verilir. Durdurma işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#setReducedMotion.name: setReducedMotion
hadi-march/motion#setReducedMotion.doc: Force reduced motion on/off (tests, user setting); null follows the system again.
hadi-march/motion#setReducedMotion.tr: Azaltılmış hareketi zorla açar/kapatır (testler, kullanıcı ayarı); null sistemi yeniden izler.

hadi-march/motion#shapeMorph.name: shapeMorph
hadi-march/motion#shapeMorph.doc: Morph an element's outline to a shape (clip-path polygon). The current outline is read from the element.
hadi-march/motion#shapeMorph.signature: function shapeMorph(el: Element, to: ShapeName, o: AnimateOptions & { points?: number } = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#shapeMorph.tr: Bir öğenin ana hattını bir şekle (clip-path çokgeni) dönüştürür. Geçerli ana hat öğeden okunur.

hadi-march/motion#shapePolygon.name: shapePolygon
hadi-march/motion#shapePolygon.doc: A clip-path polygon for a shape (n points; the same n for every shape, so they morph).
hadi-march/motion#shapePolygon.signature: function shapePolygon(shape: ShapeName, n: number = 60): string
hadi-march/motion#shapePolygon.tr: Bir şekil için clip-path çokgeni (n nokta; her şekil için aynı n, böylece dönüşebilirler).

hadi-march/motion#sharedTransition.name: sharedTransition
hadi-march/motion#sharedTransition.doc: Run `update` (which renders the next view) so that `from` morphs into the element marked `data-m-shared={name}` in the new view. Resolves when the transition has finished.
hadi-march/motion#sharedTransition.signature: function sharedTransition(name: string, from: Element | null, update: () => void | Promise<void>, o: { duration?: number } = {}): Promise<void>
hadi-march/motion#sharedTransition.tr: Sonraki görünümü çizen `update`'i çalıştırır; `from`, yeni görünümde `data-m-shared={name}` ile işaretli öğeye dönüşür. Geçiş bitince çözülür.

hadi-march/motion#spotlight.name: spotlight
hadi-march/motion#spotlight.doc: Light the cards under `root` from the pointer. Returns a function that stops it and puts the lights out.
hadi-march/motion#spotlight.signature: function spotlight(root: Document | Element, o: SpotlightOptions): () => void
hadi-march/motion#spotlight.tr: `root` altındaki kartları imleçten aydınlatır: imlece yakın bütün kartlar gerçek imleç konumundan ışık alır (iki kart arasındaki boşlukta da). Durduran ve ışıkları söndüren işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#spring.name: spring
hadi-march/motion#spring.doc: Physics spring toward `source()` (velocity carries across target changes — feels natural for drags).
hadi-march/motion#spring.signature: function spring<T extends Animatable>(source: () => T, opts: SpringOptions = {}): Animated<T>
hadi-march/motion#spring.tr: `source()` değerine doğru fizik yayı (hız hedef değişikliklerinde korunur — sürüklemelerde doğal hissettirir).

hadi-march/motion#springEase.name: springEase
hadi-march/motion#springEase.doc: A damped spring as an easing: exact physics, a natural duration, and a CSS linear() curve for WAAPI.
hadi-march/motion#springEase.tr: Yumuşatma olarak sönümlü yay: tam fizik, doğal süre ve WAAPI için CSS linear() eğrisi.

hadi-march/motion#stack.name: stack
hadi-march/motion#stack.doc: Cards stack: the new page slides over the old one, which sinks back (back: it slides off again).
hadi-march/motion#stack.tr: Kartlar yığılır: yeni sayfa eskinin üstüne kayar, eski geriye çöker (geri: yeniden dışarı kayar).

hadi-march/motion#stagger.name: stagger
hadi-march/motion#stagger.doc: Stagger helper: delay for item i (ms). `from`: "start" | "end" | "center" | "edges" | index.
hadi-march/motion#stagger.signature: function stagger(each: number = 40, o: Parameters<typeof engineStagger>[1] = {}): (i: number, total?: number) => number
hadi-march/motion#stagger.tr: Kademeli gecikme yardımcısı: i. öğe için gecikme (ms). `from`: "start" | "end" | "center" | "edges" | dizin.

hadi-march/motion#staggerIn.name: staggerIn
hadi-march/motion#staggerIn.doc: Bring a set of elements in one after another (preset keyframes, engine stagger: linear, from the centre or in a grid).
hadi-march/motion#staggerIn.signature: function staggerIn(targets: ArrayLike<Element> | string, o: StaggerInOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#staggerIn.tr: Bir öğe kümesini sırayla getirir (hazır anahtar kareler, motor kademesi: doğrusal, merkezden ya da ızgarada).

hadi-march/motion#stateMorph.name: stateMorph
hadi-march/motion#stateMorph.doc: Morph a button between states: loading narrows it to a circle with a spinner, success and error draw a check or a cross over the success / danger colour (error also shakes), idle restores it. The colours come from the theme tokens through `data-m-state` (motion.css). Returns the main Playback.
hadi-march/motion#stateMorph.signature: function stateMorph(el: Element, state: ButtonState, o: StateMorphOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#stateMorph.tr: Bir düğmeyi durumlar arasında dönüştürür: loading onu döndürücülü daireye daraltır, success ve error başarı / tehlike renginin üzerine onay veya çarpı çizer (error ayrıca sallar), idle geri yükler. Renkler temadan gelir.

hadi-march/motion#stickyReveal.name: stickyReveal
hadi-march/motion#stickyReveal.doc: A tall section with a sticky stage: as the section scrolls by, the steps come in one after another (each fades and rises in, then out). The section sets `--m-scroll` (0..1) on itself for CSS extras. Returns a stop function.
hadi-march/motion#stickyReveal.signature: function stickyReveal(section: HTMLElement, o: StickyRevealOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#stickyReveal.tr: Yapışkan sahneli uzun bölüm: bölüm kaydıkça adımlar sırayla gelir (her biri belirip yükselir, sonra çıkar). Bölüm kendi üzerine `--m-scroll` (0..1) yazar. Durdurma işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#supportsLinear.name: supportsLinear
hadi-march/motion#supportsLinear.doc: True when the browser runs CSS linear() easings (springs and bounces then stay native).
hadi-march/motion#supportsLinear.tr: Tarayıcı CSS linear() yumuşatmalarını çalıştırıyorsa true (yaylar ve sekmeler o zaman yerel kalır).

hadi-march/motion#swipe.name: swipe
hadi-march/motion#swipe.doc: Action: detect a swipe (left/right/up/down) with distance and velocity thresholds.
hadi-march/motion#swipe.signature: function swipe(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#swipe.tr: Eylem: mesafe ve hız eşikleriyle kaydırma hareketini (sol/sağ/yukarı/aşağı) algılar.

hadi-march/motion#themeWave.name: themeWave
hadi-march/motion#themeWave.doc: Run a restyle as a wave of the new look. Resolves when the wave is over.
hadi-march/motion#themeWave.signature: function themeWave(change: () => void, o: ThemeWaveOptions = {}, taken?: unknown): Promise<void>
hadi-march/motion#themeWave.tr: Bir yeniden boyamayı, `origin` noktasından büyüyen yeni görünüm dairesi olarak çalıştırır (Görünüm Geçişi yoksa, azaltılmış harekette ya da duraklatılmışken anında). Dalga bitince çözülür.

hadi-march/motion#tilt.name: tilt
hadi-march/motion#tilt.doc: Action: 3D tilt toward the pointer (max degrees), with an optional glare via --m-tilt-x/--m-tilt-y custom properties.
hadi-march/motion#tilt.signature: function tilt(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#tilt.tr: Eylem: işaretçiye doğru 3B eğim (en çok derece), --m-tilt-x/--m-tilt-y özel özellikleriyle isteğe bağlı parlama.

hadi-march/motion#timeline.name: timeline
hadi-march/motion#timeline.doc: A timeline: add steps (`at`, labels, stagger), then control them as one. Paused until play().
hadi-march/motion#timeline.signature: function timeline(opts: AnimateOptions & { defaults?: AnimateOptions } = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#timeline.tr: Zaman çizelgesi: adımlar ekleyin (`at`, etiketler, stagger), sonra tek parça olarak denetleyin. play() çağrılana dek duraklatılmış.

hadi-march/motion#toD.name: toD
hadi-march/motion#toD.signature: function toD(pts: ArrayLike<number>, closed: boolean): string

hadi-march/motion#toLinear.name: toLinear
hadi-march/motion#toLinear.doc: Sample `fn` into a CSS linear() easing (points that a straight line already covers are dropped).
hadi-march/motion#toLinear.signature: function toLinear(fn: (t: number) => number, points: number = 48): string
hadi-march/motion#toLinear.tr: `fn` işlevini CSS linear() yumuşatmasına örnekler (düz bir çizginin zaten kapsadığı noktalar atılır).

hadi-march/motion#track.name: track
hadi-march/motion#track.doc: A signal that follows `source()` smoothly. Cleans up with the current owner.
hadi-march/motion#track.signature: function track<T extends number | number[]>(source: () => T, opts: TrackOptions = {}): Tracked<T>
hadi-march/motion#track.tr: `source()` değerini yumuşakça izleyen bir sinyal. Geçerli sahiple birlikte temizlenir.

hadi-march/motion#Track.name: Track
hadi-march/motion#Track.doc: A compiled property track. Drivers read `out` (numbers) or `text()` (CSS string).

ctor.text: new Track(raw: RawTrack, current: () => Value): Track

members.name: prop
members.summary: The name of the animated property.

hadi-march/motion#Track.tr: Derlenmiş özellik izi. Sürücüler `out` (sayılar) veya `text()` (CSS dizesi) okur.

hadi-march/motion#transitionFrames.name: transitionFrames
hadi-march/motion#transitionFrames.doc: The keyframes of one side of a page transition (back reverses it; RTL mirrors "slide").
hadi-march/motion#transitionFrames.signature: function transitionFrames(type: PageTransitionType, side: "in" | "out", dir: Dir, rtl: boolean = false, distance: number = 32): Keyframe[]
hadi-march/motion#transitionFrames.tr: Sayfa geçişinin bir tarafının anahtar kareleri (geri onu tersine çevirir; RTL "slide" geçişini yansıtır).

hadi-march/motion#tween.name: tween
hadi-march/motion#tween.doc: Smoothly animate toward `source()` whenever it changes (duration-based).
hadi-march/motion#tween.signature: function tween<T extends Animatable>(source: () => T, opts: TweenOptions = {}): Animated<T>
hadi-march/motion#tween.tr: `source()` her değiştiğinde ona doğru yumuşakça canlanır (süre tabanlı).

hadi-march/motion#usePageTransitions.name: usePageTransitions
hadi-march/motion#usePageTransitions.doc: Register variants so routes can name them in `meta.transition`.
hadi-march/motion#usePageTransitions.tr: Rotaların `meta.transition` içinde adlandırabilmesi için varyantları kaydeder.

hadi-march/motion#viewTransition.name: viewTransition
hadi-march/motion#viewTransition.doc: Run a DOM update as a View Transition where supported (the browser animates old → new snapshots on the compositor); without support, with reduced motion or while paused, the update simply runs.
hadi-march/motion#viewTransition.tr: Desteklenen yerde bir DOM güncellemesini Görünüm Geçişi olarak çalıştırır (tarayıcı eski → yeni anlık görüntüleri bileşimleyicide canlandırır); destek yoksa, azaltılmış harekette veya duraklatılmışken güncelleme doğrudan çalışır.

hadi-march/motion#webgl.name: webgl
hadi-march/motion#webgl.doc: A WebGL program as an animation target: every field of `state` is a uniform (number → float, [x, y] → vec2, colors → vec4 in sRGB 0..1). `uniforms` maps a field to another uniform name. `draw(gl)` issues the draw call.
hadi-march/motion#webgl.signature: function webgl<S extends object>(gl: GL, program: WebGLProgram, o: { state: S; draw: (gl: GL, state: S) => void; uniforms?: Record<string, string> }): WebGLTarget<S>

params.name: o
params.type: { state: S; draw: (gl: GL, state: S) => void; uniforms?: Record<string, string> }

hadi-march/motion#webgl.tr: Animasyon hedefi olarak WebGL programı: `state` içindeki her alan bir uniform'dur (sayı → float, [x, y] → vec2, renkler → sRGB 0..1 vec4). `uniforms` bir alanı başka bir uniform adına eşler. `draw(gl)` çizim çağrısını yapar.

hadi-march/motion#wipe.name: wipe
hadi-march/motion#wipe.doc: A straight wipe from the inline end (forward) or start (back); mirrored in RTL.
hadi-march/motion#wipe.tr: Satır içi sondan (ileri) veya başlangıçtan (geri) düz silme; RTL'de yansıtılır.

hadi-march/motion#yieldToMain.name: yieldToMain
hadi-march/motion#yieldToMain.doc: Give the main thread back (scheduler.yield where available): long setup work stays under the 50 ms long-task line.
hadi-march/motion#yieldToMain.tr: Ana iş parçacığını geri verir (varsa scheduler.yield): uzun kurulum işleri 50 ms uzun görev sınırının altında kalır.

hadi-march/motion#zoomThrough.name: zoomThrough
hadi-march/motion#zoomThrough.doc: Fly through: the old page grows past the viewer, the new one comes up from the distance (back: the reverse).
hadi-march/motion#zoomThrough.tr: İçinden uçuş: eski sayfa izleyicinin yanından büyüyerek geçer, yenisi uzaktan yaklaşır (geri: tersi).

hadi-march/motion/text#blurIn.name: blurIn
hadi-march/motion/text#blurIn.signature: function blurIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

hadi-march/motion/text#bounce.name: bounce
hadi-march/motion/text#bounce.signature: function bounce(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

hadi-march/motion/text#bounceIn.name: bounceIn
hadi-march/motion/text#bounceIn.doc: Characters fall and bounce on the baseline.
hadi-march/motion/text#bounceIn.signature: function bounceIn(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
hadi-march/motion/text#bounceIn.tr: Karakterler düşer ve taban çizgisinde zıplar.

hadi-march/motion/text#breathe.name: breathe
hadi-march/motion/text#breathe.doc: Letter spacing breathes in and out (letter-spacing).
hadi-march/motion/text#breathe.signature: function breathe(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
hadi-march/motion/text#breathe.tr: Harf aralığı nefes alır gibi açılıp kapanır (letter-spacing).

hadi-march/motion/text#cascade.name: cascade
hadi-march/motion/text#cascade.doc: Characters tumble down from above, turning.
hadi-march/motion/text#cascade.signature: function cascade(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

hadi-march/motion/text#counter.name: counter
hadi-march/motion/text#counter.doc: Counts up to the number in the text, formatted for the locale.
hadi-march/motion/text#counter.signature: function counter(el: El, o: CounterOptions = {}): TextAnimation
hadi-march/motion/text#counter.tr: Metindeki sayıya kadar sayar, dile göre biçimlendirir.

hadi-march/motion/text#decode.name: decode
hadi-march/motion/text#decode.doc: Characters appear as flickering binary in random order, then decode.
hadi-march/motion/text#decode.signature: function decode(el: El, o: ScrambleOptions = {}): TextAnimation
hadi-march/motion/text#decode.tr: Karakterler rastgele sırayla titreşen ikili kod olarak belirir, sonra çözülür.

hadi-march/motion/text#dissolve.name: dissolve
hadi-march/motion/text#dissolve.doc: Characters appear in random order, like a slow dissolve.
hadi-march/motion/text#dissolve.signature: function dissolve(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
hadi-march/motion/text#dissolve.tr: Karakterler yavaş bir çözülme gibi rastgele sırayla belirir.

hadi-march/motion/text#drop.name: drop
hadi-march/motion/text#drop.signature: function drop(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

hadi-march/motion/text#elastic.name: elastic
hadi-march/motion/text#elastic.doc: Characters stretch in on an elastic spring.
hadi-march/motion/text#elastic.signature: function elastic(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

hadi-march/motion/text#explode.name: explode
hadi-march/motion/text#explode.doc: Characters burst apart and vanish (an exit; `out: true` assembles them instead).
hadi-march/motion/text#explode.signature: function explode(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
hadi-march/motion/text#explode.tr: Karakterler dağılıp kaybolur (bir çıkış; `out: true` bunun yerine onları bir araya getirir).

hadi-march/motion/text#fade.name: fade
hadi-march/motion/text#fade.signature: function fade(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation

hadi-march/motion/text#flip.name: flip
hadi-march/motion/text#flip.signature: function flip(el: El, o?: TextOptions): TextAnimation
